nodes.name: buildSpaceDestinations.ts
nodes.summary: Unifies git repositories and marketplaces into a single 'destination' model for the space distribution surface, computing drift status, reach summaries, batch eligibility and search filtering.

nodes.name: destinationDriftStatus
nodes.summary: Maps a destination's drift and failure counts to a single drift status value.

nodes.name: buildSpaceDestinations
nodes.summary: Combines repository and marketplace drift data into a sorted list of space destinations.

nodes.name: destinationReachSummary
nodes.summary: Summarizes how many repositories and marketplaces a set of destinations reaches, for display copy.

nodes.name: isBatchDistributable
nodes.summary: Tells whether a destination can be included in a batch distribution.

nodes.name: searchDestinations
nodes.summary: Filters destinations by a free-text query across repository, marketplace and package names.

nodes.name: lockFileSync.ts
nodes.summary: Centralized UI copy (labels, tooltips, toast texts and warning messages) for syncing a repository's lock file back into Packmind.

nodes.name: syncFromRepositoryTooltip
nodes.summary: Builds the tooltip text for the 'sync from repository' action.

nodes.name: syncRepositoryLabel
nodes.summary: Returns the label for syncing a given repository.

nodes.name: syncRepositoryTooltip
nodes.summary: Builds the tooltip for syncing a repository's lock file.

nodes.name: syncBrokenConnection
nodes.summary: Message explaining a sync cannot run because the git connection is broken.

nodes.name: syncedToastTitle
nodes.summary: Title of the toast shown after a successful lock file sync.

nodes.name: syncedToastDescription
nodes.summary: Description of the post-sync toast summarizing what was synced.

nodes.name: olderCliLocksMessage
nodes.summary: Warning message for lock files written by an older CLI version.

nodes.name: unknownPackagesMessage
nodes.summary: Warning message listing packages in the lock file unknown to Packmind.

nodes.name: unknownPackagesFix
nodes.summary: Suggested fix text for unknown packages found in a lock file.

nodes.name: noGitConnection.ts
nodes.summary: String constants explaining missing or broken git connections in the deployments UI, including titles, body text, CTA labels and tooltips.

nodes.name: DeploymentsOverviewRedesign.tsx
nodes.summary: Top-level redesigned deployments overview page that loads distributed packages, builds package/repository drift overviews and composes master rails, detail panes and the sync surface; supports a DEV-only stub mode.

nodes.name: DeploymentsOverviewRedesign
nodes.summary: Wrapper resolving the current space and organization before rendering the deployments overview content.

nodes.name: DeploymentsOverviewRedesignContent
nodes.summary: Main body of the overview: loads deployments (or stubs), builds drift overviews, manages selection/mode state and renders rails, panes and sync surface.

nodes.name: buildRepoBulkScope
nodes.summary: Builds the bulk sync scope for a set of selected repositories.

nodes.name: SummaryLine
nodes.summary: Renders the headline summary of drifted/failed packages or repositories.

nodes.name: Metric
nodes.summary: Small presentational component showing a labelled metric value.

nodes.name: Backlink
nodes.summary: Renders a back navigation link to the parent page.

nodes.name: LoadingState
nodes.summary: Loading placeholder for the overview.

nodes.name: ErrorState
nodes.summary: Error placeholder shown when deployments fail to load.

nodes.name: EmptyState
nodes.summary: Empty state shown when no packages are distributed.

nodes.name: DestinationChangeList.tsx
nodes.summary: React components listing the component-level changes a destination will receive, both for live-tracking destinations and for destinations pinned to a package release.

nodes.name: ChangeRow
nodes.summary: Renders a single component change (added, updated, removed) for a destination.

nodes.name: DestinationChangeList
nodes.summary: Lists the live changes a destination will receive on the next distribution.

nodes.name: PinnedDestinationChanges
nodes.summary: Fetches and lists the changes a destination pinned to a release would receive when moved to a newer release.

nodes.name: DriftArtifactRow.tsx
nodes.summary: Row component displaying a single drifting artifact (standard, command or skill) with its version gap and a reason indicator (behind, needs removal, not distributed).

nodes.name: DriftArtifactRow
nodes.summary: Renders a drifting artifact row with kind, name, version gap and reason.

nodes.name: DriftReasonIndicator
nodes.summary: Shows an icon/label explaining why the artifact drifts.
